datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field surveys across Zimbabwe to classify acute food insecurity conditions using the IPC framework. Geographic data with IPC phase classifications were compiled for medium-term projections at four time points in 2014 (January, April, July, October), with each classification linked to underlying hazard conditions and requiring assistance indicators.

sources.name: FEWS NET
sources.description: Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) spatial data collected through regular enumerator surveys. IPC classifications represent acute food insecurity severity levels linked to underlying hazards including drought.
